172:t_017:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Yes... $$ランド$$ and the others and I fought that man on $$翠の地球$$.」

172:t_017:12.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「That's right... We fought together as allies... then came to hate each other as enemies...」

172:t_017:13.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I... don't fight out of hatred.」

172:t_017:14.en:
$$シン$$
(That's right... I'm sure $$セツコ$$ is the one who taught me that...)

172:t_017:15.en:
$$シン$$
(What I have to do now is...!)

172:t_017:16.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You can do this, $$シン$$, right?」

172:t_018:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「It seems you're all ready. Now I can crush you without any regrets, $c.」

172:t_018:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Oh my... $$ハマーン・カーン$$. You're far kinder than the rumors say.」

172:t_018:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... I have not wholeheartedly agreed to join hands with you.」

172:t_018:4.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Well, well... how bold of you, with no regard for your own position.」

172:t_018:6.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha... it seems you're a bit different from that $$フル・フロンタル$$ after all.」

172:t_018:7.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Joking aside, shall we each carry out our missions, yes?」

172:t_018:10.en:
$$ハマーン$$
($c, $$シャア$$... I will simply walk my own path...!)

172:t_018:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, intercept $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and the $$サイデリアル$$! And do not lay a hand on $$プラント$$!」

172:t_018:12.en:
$$シン$$
「Watch, $$レイ#pt136$$! This is our fight!」

172:t_019:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「All enemy units have been shot down or have retreated!」

172:t_019:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$シン$$... Staying here like this, there's nothing we can do.」

172:t_019:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We can intercept those who attack us, but we can't take control of $$プラント$$.」

172:t_019:5.en:
$$シン$$
「Even so, if we leave it like this...!」

172:t_019:12.en:
$$キラ$$
「...The enemy we must fight is war itself. Not $$プラント$$.」

172:t_019:13.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$アスラン$$ and the others are still in $$プラント$$. Let's leave it to them for now.」

172:t_019:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「All units, fall back! Hurry!」

172:t_019:16.en:
$$シン$$
($$レイ#pt136$$... I will stop you, no matter what...)

172:t_020:0.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「$$シン$$... everyone... I fight... of my own will...」

172:t_020:1.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
(《$$ギル$$》... I finally understand the meaning of what you were trying to do...)

172:t_021:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「This is the end, $$ハマーン$$! If you intend to keep fighting any longer...」

172:t_021:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Who do you think you're talking to...!」

172:t_021:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Colonel $$シャア$$ fights with his own strength, without relying on the $$ジオン$$ name! You, too...」

172:t_021:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Silence, $$カミーユ・ビダン$$! I have no need of $$シャア$$ anymore!」

172:t_021:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I will change this world my own way!」

172:t_022:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「No use chasing her, $$カミーユ$$. Once a woman gets like that, there's no handling her.」

172:t_022:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「It is the issue, $$カトル$$. My gut says so too.」

172:t_022:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$ハマーン$$... You, too, have your heart held captive by the $$赤い彗星$$...)

172:t_023:0.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ha ha ha... After this, I can't laugh at $$ギルター$$. I must go home and make my excuses to the boss.」

172:t_023:2.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Let us meet again, $$セツコ$$. My boss wishes for that as well.」

172:t_024:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I'll repay that debt in time. To his master as well, all at once.」

172:t_025:1.en:
$n
「I can't stay an inexperienced rookie forever.」

172:t_025:2.en:
$n
(To protect what's precious to me, I have to get even stronger...!)

172:t_026:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What amazing teamwork... We can't lose either, $n.」

172:t_026:1.en:
$n
「I know...! Here I go, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

172:t_026:2.en:
$n
(To protect what's precious to me, I have to get even stronger...!)

172:t_100:0.en:
$$シン$$
(I couldn't care less about how the $$コーディネイター$$s began...! I am who I am!)

172:t_100:1.en:
$$シン$$
(I refuse to be bound by ties to the past! I fight for what I believe in!)

172:t_101:0.en:
$$キラ$$
($$ラクス$$... You learned the truth, and you've endured all this time until today, haven't you...)

172:t_101:1.en:
$$キラ$$
(From today on, I'll carry half of that weight... And...)

172:t_101:2.en:
$$キラ$$
(I'll surely seize the peace and the future you hope for...! With this feeling and this power!)

172:t_102:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ really are moving their main force to $$蒼の地球$$...」

172:t_102:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll stop them...! And the chain of sorrow...!」

172:t_102:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「With $$バルゴラ$$, our pride, which has gained this new power!」

172:t_103:0.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$! For the sake of $$ラプラスの箱$$, too, I'll take you and the $$ユニコーン$$!」

172:t_103:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This Gundam was entrusted to me by Father...! And $$オードリー$$ entrusted the box to me!」

172:t_103:2.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Her Highness $$ミネバ$$ entrusted it to you...!?」

172:t_103:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ハマーン・カーン$$! If you intend to stop the war together with $$オードリー$$, go to Colonel $$シャア$$!」

172:t_103:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Captain $$ジンネマン$$ and $$マリーダ$$ are there, too!」

172:t_103:5.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「I see... So Her Highness is with that man...」

172:t_103:6.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Is that how that man moves people, purely for his own convenience!」

172:t_103:7.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That's not it, $$ハマーン$$!」

172:t_103:8.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Too familiar! Don't think you're guaranteed safety just because you're the key to the box!」
